description: Changes one existing wording on a webinar and leaves everything else alone. Take it when a single line is wrong and you do not want a rebuild. A host says: "The date in the second paragraph is old, just fix that line." It needs the session, the webinar, the exact current wording as it stands on the site, and the new wording. It also needs to know where the line stands: a block on the page, text inside the page code, a field of the campaign copy, or the page heading. It writes on your site and participants see it at once. When the same wording stands more than once, the site refuses instead of guessing. The answer carries the old wording, so the same call puts it back. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: change one line, fix a wording, edit page text, replace a sentence

all.description: page_code only: true replaces every exact hit outside shortcodes. Leave it out to change exactly one spot.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

find.description: The current wording, copied word for word from the site. Left out only for target page_heading.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

surface.description: Which page the target belongs to. Default registration.

target.description: Where the wording stands. One target per call.

value.description: The new wording, taken verbatim. Needed for every target.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_text
title: Change one text of a webinar
